worldcombat.skill.captivate.summary: Meet an opposite-gender foe's gaze to harshly lower its Sp. Atk; same-gender Pokemon are immune and non-Pokemon have no gender. You may also dance on the spot to captivate every non-friendly that sees it.
worldcombat.skill.captivate.use.1: Captivate several enemies at once while they cluster
worldcombat.skill.captivate.use.2: Pressure enemies in tight cover where projectiles fail
The single target caught by the gaze immediately loses %1$s Sp. Atk stage(s) and carries the Captivated mark for %2$s; repeated casts keep lowering it, down to the −6 floor.
The gaze holds a single target, up to %1$s blocks away; Dance instead sweeps a ring of radius %2$s around you and catches up to %3$s non-friendly bodies inside that can see it.

Setting the pose takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown; Dance winds up 5 ticks longer and cools down at 1.3x. Pokemon require the opposite gender (same-gender Pokemon are immune); non-Pokemon have no gender and are always valid.
worldcombat.skill.captivate.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.captivate.preference.p: Glance holds one chosen foe with a short windup and cooldown; Dance sweeps a ring around you and captivates every non-friendly that sees it, but winds up and cools down slower and forces you into the crowd.
worldcombat.skill.captivate.preference.a: The companion only considers the gaze while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
Countering uses it only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime gazes at any threat.
In Dance posture, the companion only performs with at least this many non-friendly bodies nearby, so the windup is not wasted; 1 means dance whenever it sees one.
When on, the companion may leave its post to captivate under a Hold order.
